_comment: Cast from the ElevenLabs premade voice set. Chosen for aural distinctness first:
the player has no faces, so no two speakers may share age + gender + register.
noema   River    neutral, unplaceable - it is not a person and must not sound like one
bloch   George   mature British storyteller; authority without effort
okonjo  Alice    'clear, engaging educator' = her measured lecturer's timing exactly
farrow  Liam     young, energetic American; the only fast talker in the cast
haugen  Sarah    mature, confident; run slow and flat for the clipped Norwegian read
rhee    Eric     smooth and soft; the most honest person in the building
reader  Matilda  professional and affectless - the 1983 numbers voice
nils    Bill     'wise, mature' - audibly older than Bloch, which is the point
child   Jessica  bright and high; the only child line in the game
pa      Daniel   'steady broadcaster' - literally a public address voice
Replace any of these with a Voice Design result for a closer read; the child and
NOEMA are the two most worth designing bespoke.
